classification.difficultyReason: Four points with directed angles from the x-axis. The student needs reference angles, quadrant signs and exact values for both coordinates, but no reading of unusual angle markings.

content.prompt:
The points $P,Q,R,S$ are on the unit circle. $O$ is the origin.
Find the exact coordinates of $P,Q,R,S$.

answer.worked:
On the unit circle, coordinates are $(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$ for the directed angle $\theta$ from the positive $x$-axis.
$$\begin{align*}P&=(\cos135^\circ,\sin135^\circ)=\left(-\cos45^\circ,\sin45^\circ\right)=\left(-\frac{1}{\sqrt2},\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\right)\\Q&=(\cos210^\circ,\sin210^\circ)=\left(-\cos30^\circ,-\sin30^\circ\right)=\left(-\frac{\sqrt3}{2},-\frac12\right)\\R&=(\cos300^\circ,\sin300^\circ)=\left(\cos60^\circ,-\sin60^\circ\right)=\left(\frac12,-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)\\S&=(\cos30^\circ,\sin30^\circ)=\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2},\frac12\right)\end{align*}$$
